title: citronella mucronata
intro: Citronella mucronata, commonly known as Yellow Citronella, is a plant species native to South Africa, characterized by its yellow flowers and leaves with a distinctive citrusy scent. The health benefits of Citronella mucronata include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and protect against infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to calm and relax the mind and body, making it a natural remedy for anxiety, insomnia, and stress relief. The bioactive constituents of Citronella mucronata include limonene, pinene, and beta-pinene, which contribute to its medicinal properties and fragrance.
